item.title: Join Us for the Front & Marconi Two-Way Conversion Launch Event! (Tues, Nov 12 @11AM)
item.description:
The City of Columbus is thrilled to announce the completion of the Front Street and Marconi Boulevard Improvements Project.

Transforming these key Downtown streets for a safer, more accessible, and connected community. 

Learn about the vision behind this project and how these improvements will benefit Downtown Columbus from City leaders, Stakeholders and Community Members as we celebrate another step toward a more vibrant and accessible city.

We hope to see you there to mark this transformation!

About the Project

The City of Columbus improvements project Downtown converts Front Street to two-way traffic from East Broad Street to Hickory Street, and Marconi Boulevard from East Broad Street to Spring Street. Infrastructure improvements include new curbs, sidewalks and street lighting, signage and pavement markings, and upgraded traffic signals and enhanced crosswalks for greater visibility.

The conversion from multiple lanes of one-way traffic to two-way flow has safety and access benefits.

  • Two-way traffic helps to reduce vehicle speeds and create safe conditions for everyone who uses the roadway, including people crossing the street.
  • This is the last one-way section of Front Street. The conversion to two-way provides uniform traffic movement on the Front Street corridor and alleviates driver confusion. The Front Street intersection at Hickory Street is reconfigured to support two-way traffic.
  • On Marconi Boulevard, two-way traffic flow aligns with the two-way pattern on Civic Center Drive where Marconi crosses East Broad Street.
  • In partnership with COTA, the two-way conversion adds bus service and a shelter southbound on Front Street, with service beginning this January
  • Front Street and Marconi Boulevard have high vehicle and pedestrian usage by people accessing businesses, offices, government buildings and amenities in this area. The conversion makes it easier to navigate to and from these destinations.

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Update - October 18, 2024)
item.description:
Oct. 18, 2024

Construction is in the final stages on the city’s project to convert Front St and Marconi Blvd to two-way traffic sometime in November.

Expect additional traffic impacts for approximately the next 3 to 4 weeks. Please stay aware of shifting lane closures and no parking restrictions while crews complete pavement milling, resurfacing and striping in the project area on Front St, Marconi Blvd, Broad St, and Long and Spring streets between Front and Marconi. Broad St paving will be completed during nighttime work.

Access will continue to be maintained to City Hall and the city parking garages on Front St and on Ludlow St off Long St. 

More information will be shared with you about timing of the traffic pattern switch to two-way as construction is completed, signage is installed and the new traffic signals are activated.

Thanks,

DPS Project Team

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Update - May 23, 2024)
item.description:
May 23, 2024

Starting on Tuesday morning, May 28,  the second phase of construction on Front St will shift to the west side of the street. No on-street parking will be allowed on Front St between Gay St and Long St. Parking will be maintained on Front between Gay St and Broad St for access to City Hall until the work on Marconi Blvd is completed between Gay and Broad.

Construction continues to progress on Marconi. Traffic flow remains at two travel lanes maintained on Marconi between Spring St and Long St, and one lane maintained south of Long to Broad plus a left turn lane at Broad.

Thanks,

DPS Project Team

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Update - April 29, 2024)
item.description:
April 29, 2024

On Wednesday, May 1, the next phase of construction on Marconi Blvd will shift to the east side of the roadway, and traffic flow will shift to be maintained in the western lane(s). Two travel lanes will continue to be maintained on Marconi between Spring St and Long St, and one lane will be maintained south of Long St to Broad St.

All driveways will remain accessible, and detailed signage and markers will remain in place to safely guide drivers and pedestrians crossing Marconi.

Overall, progress on the project is proceeding smoothly, and we anticipate no issues in meeting the Red White and Boom Marconi Blvd requirements. Thank you for your continued patience as the project’s construction progresses on Marconi and on Front St.

Thanks,

DPS Project Team

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Update - March 28, 2024)
item.description:
March 28, 2024

Good Afternoon,

Effective Monday morning, April 1, 2024, the Gay St. crosswalk on Marconi Blvd. along with the sidewalk south of the Federal Courthouse, will be closed for construction.

The Long St. crosswalk on Marconi Blvd. will be reopened, along with the sidewalk in front of the Federal Courthouse down to the south entrance, including the handicap ramp.

The current detour directing pedestrian traffic to the Gay St. crosswalk will be removed and reversed, redirecting traffic to use the Long St. crossing instead. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Thanks,

DPS Project Team

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Update - January 26, 2024)
item.description:
January 26, 2024

Good Afternoon,

This is a reminder that, this i January 29th, the project construction will progress to Marconi Blvd. The work zone will reduce travel to two lanes on Marconi starting at Spring St. and to one lane on Marconi south of Long St. On-street parking will be reduced in the area to allow for construction. This construction phase will continue until the Fourth of July celebration of Red, White and Boom. Thank you for your continued patience as work progresses on this project.

Thanks,

DPS Project Team

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Weekly Update - November 3, 2023)
item.description:
November 3, 2023

There are no significant changes to the current project conditions since our last update.

Front St. will continue to be reduced to two lanes as contractors work on intersections (Lynn, Elm, Gay, Lafayette, Long, Spring), using lane closures and steel plates. Work will continue into winter with traffic maintained as needed.

Daily lane adjustments will be accompanied by flagged operations for equipment access during trench crossings. Steel plates will be deployed to keep traffic flowing while pavement restoration occurs.

Thanks,

DPS Project Team

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Weekly Update - October 6, 2023)
item.description:
October 19, 2023

Front St. will be reduced to two lanes. Contractors will work on intersections (Lynn, Elm, Gay, Lafayette, Long, Spring), using lane closures and steel plates. Work will continue into winter with traffic maintained as needed.

The contractor issued a 14-day notice, stating that work will commence on 10/26/2023. This is a change from the initial projection of an early to mid-November start on Broad St.

Daily lane adjustments will be accompanied by flagged operations for equipment access during trench crossings. Steel plates will be deployed to keep traffic flowing while pavement restoration occurs.

Thanks,

Jacob Slechter, PE

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Weekly Update - October 6, 2023)
item.description:
Good Morning,

On October 16, 2023 contractors will have crews that are going to start out on Broad St. that will be impacting traffic. 

Traffic will be impacted on Broad St. from the Broad St. bridge to High St with lane closures. The contractor will be moving traffic around while constructing a trench that goes across Broad St. I’ve highlighted that below as well as Marconi which we’ll be progressing next (won’t be till late October).

The work will be plated each day and will NOT require a 24/7 lane closures. The work will be conducted from 9am – 3pm. Steel plates and lane closures will be posted to the CLOSE program for further info.

Thanks,

Jacob Slechter, PE

item.title: Front & Marconi Two Way Conversion Project (Weekly Update - June 26, 2023)
item.description:
Good Morning,

Last week saw good progress on the temporary traffic signal work including installation of wood poles. Parking spaces on Front St. have been impacted, and pedestrian detours were necessary to safely conduct this work along Front St. signalized intersections.

The upcoming weeks will continue to see similar traffic setups as the crews continue to install the temporary signals along Front St. This will include pedestrian detours and parking spaces being impacted. Short-term lane closures will be required while crews move equipment in and around the corners of these intersections. This work is anticipated to continue, with crews pulling off the site for the City of Columbus Red, White and Boom! celebration. No work on Marconi Blvd is anticipated prior to the 4th of July.

Thank you for your cooperation. Together, we will successfully complete the Front and Marconi construction project to fully convert the streets to two-way traffic and create a safer and more accessible downtown area.

Thanks,

Jacob Slechter, PE
